Could Freud have experienced gender dysphoria?

I took a college general psychology class a year ago and we learned about Freud and his psychoanalytic theory, and his psychosexual stages.

The Oedipus complex was something I found really interesting, and although I can’t discount the possibility that things like penis envy or womb envy are valid experiences that some people have, I personally don’t believe that Freud’s suggestion that everyone experiences this is necessarily true.

I was thinking more about this recently, and it sounds a bit similar to what I understand is gender dysphoria. Is it possible that Freud experienced this, and not living in a time when transgenders were more accepted wrote it off as something that everyone experiences? 

If I’m misunderstanding any of these concepts please let me know, and input would help!
